address: via Vittorio Emanuele II 136, Venosa, 85029, Italy
bio: Housed in a 15C building in the centre of town, this restaurant boasts beautiful vaulted ceilings and a smart, elegant ambience. The young owner-chef serves cuisine with a traditional focus which is reinterpreted in modern style and made from excellent regional ingredients, as well as a few fish options. Efficient, punctual service....
